notes: This file contains the Prometheus query results behind every target in the provisioned ScaleLab Grafana dashboard.
Each sample is [Unix timestamp in seconds, string value]. Missing timestamps represent periods when no sample was available.
Values are already transformed by the dashboard PromQL expressions; units are defined by their corresponding Grafana panels.

queries.panelTitle: p95 / p99 response time by instance
p95 / p99 response time by instance

queries.originalExpression: (100 * sum by (instance_id) (rate(scalelab_http_requests_total{instance_id=~"$instance",status_code=~"4..|5.."}[30s])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance_id) (rate(scalelab_http_requests_total{instance_id=~"$instance"}[30s])), 0.000000001)) or on(instance_id) (0 * sum by (instance_id) (rate(scalelab_http_requests_total{instance_id=~"$instance"}[30s])))
queries.expression: (100 * sum by (instance_id) (rate(scalelab_http_requests_total{instance_id=~".*",status_code=~"4..|5.."}[30s])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance_id) (rate(scalelab_http_requests_total{instance_id=~".*"}[30s])), 0.000000001)) or on(instance_id) (0 * sum by (instance_id) (rate(scalelab_http_requests_total{instance_id=~".*"}[30s])))
